what: On page open, a background-colored curtain covering the screen folds vertically (height scale 1 → 0) around its top edge, rolling up over 2s to reveal the screen below — the default CSS ease, quick at first then a long tail. Once fully folded the curtain is hidden and fx:done fires

options.dur: Fold duration (sec), default 2 — 0 means it lifts away instantly
options.on: With load, folding starts after the window load (hero with many photos) — default is two frames after attach

use: — At the very start of body

from.where: shared.css · shared.js .mk-veil (opening veil — original Studio screen-fixed panel, its background-color child is .appear{scale:1 1} → scale 1 1e-10 2000ms, top center origin)
